main.title: Step Inside Medieval Florence
main.subheading:
Select a video to travel back in time to fourtheen-century Florence, Italy, and discover where two paintings in the NCMA's collection were originally displayed.

Explore digital re-creations of the churches for which these works were made more than 600 years ago.
main.credit: Digital reconstructions by and George Bent and Dave Pfaff, Washington and Lee University

videos.title: Inside Santa Croce
videos.description:
Step inside a digital re-creation of the church of Santa Croce in Florence, Italy, to see where Giotto’s Raleigh altarpiece once stood.

Discover how the painting was originally displayed in the Peruzzi Chapel alongside other works of art.

videos.title: Inside Orsanmichele
videos.description:
Step inside a digital re-creation of Orsanmichele in Florence, Italy, to see where Matteo di Pacino’s panel for the Guild of Doctors and Apothecaries once hung.

Discover how paintings like this one were part of everyday religious life.
